---
title: "2D Network Diffusion"
subtitle: "Multi-dimensional diffusion with broadcasting edge functions"
---

Extends the [NetworkDynamics.jl Getting Started tutorial](https://juliadynamics.github.io/NetworkDynamics.jl/stable/generated/getting_started_with_network_dynamics/) to 2D diffusion — each node has two state variables ($x$, $\phi$), both marked as coupling variables. The edge function broadcasts over all dimensions using `e_dst .= v_src .- v_dst`.

## YAML Specification

```{python}
#| echo: false
from IPython.display import Code, Markdown
Code(filename="yaml/diffusion_2d.yaml", language="yaml")
```

## Model Report

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from tvbo import SimulationExperiment
exp = SimulationExperiment.from_file("yaml/diffusion_2d.yaml")
Markdown(exp.generate_report())
```

## Generated Julia Code

```{python}
from tvbo import SimulationExperiment
exp = SimulationExperiment.from_file("yaml/diffusion_2d.yaml")
Code(exp.render_code("networkdynamics"), language='julia')
```

## Run & Plot

```{python}
ts = exp.run(format="networkdynamics")
ts.plot()
```
